description: Direct Rust dependencies Mapper may declare, each with the reason it is needed (security review of Phase 1). Adding a crate means adding it here with a reason in the PR; transitive crates are checked by deny.toml and the imports baseline.

dependencies.tauri: app framework: windows, web views, tray, IPC (default features off, see Cargo.toml)
dependencies.serde: IPC payloads and the config file
dependencies.serde_json: IPC payloads and the config file
dependencies.webview2-com: WebView2 settings Tauri does not expose: idle mode, permission denial, no browser shortcuts
dependencies.window-vibrancy: Mica / Acrylic / Blur backdrops of Mapper's own windows
dependencies.windows: Win32 calls of Mapper's own code (platform/win only); exact features pinned in deny.toml
dependencies.windows-version: Windows build number for the start-up log
dependencies.ureq: the update check: one HTTPS GET to GitHub Releases a day at most (src-tauri/src/update only, guard rule)

build-dependencies.tauri-build: embeds the manifest and generates the per-window ACL
